# Copilot instructions

- Keep the project focused on a real-time CCTV AI monitoring starter.
- Default to Python + FastAPI for the backend and a simple HTML dashboard for the UI.
- Use placeholder values for production credentials and note that Gmail SMTP, RTSP URLs, and detection models need real configuration.
- Prefer modular services for camera registry, detection, alerting, and email delivery.
- Keep everything runnable locally with a minimal dependency set.
